title: Dot Icon Studio built-in gallery image candidates
scope: Asset-only image generation. No project files were edited and no browser or Sites actions were run.
generation_method: Built-in image_gen.imagegen; one separate tool call per requested character asset. Original outputs remain under CODEX_HOME/generated_images and were copied to the requested /tmp folder.
verification_method: PNG IHDR and decoded RGBA scanlines checked with Python standard library; SHA-256 computed from copied PNG bytes. Each copied candidate was opened with view_image.
alpha_interpretation: Each file has alpha=0 background pixels and alpha=255 pixels. Most fur/material pixels are high alpha but not exactly 255; exact counts are recorded. Bounds are recorded both for every alpha>0 fringe pixel and for the visible subject at alpha>=16.
framing_note: ImageGen did not consistently achieve the requested approximately 10% margins. The measured alpha>=16 subject bounds and per-side margins are recorded for integration layout decisions.
acceptance_boundary: All ten are unaccepted visual candidates. None has user webpage acceptance.

assets.prompt:
Use case: Dot Icon Studio built-in character gallery asset.
Image 1 is the style and material reference: match its premium soft 3D collectible toy rendering, fine short plush fibers, gentle studio lighting, polished but warm finish, frontal centered presentation.
Create one complete floating character only: a perfectly round rose-pink plush orb, with two small glossy black oval eyes on the front and delicate transparent round eyeglasses fitted naturally against the plush surface. Keep both eyes visible through the lenses. No mouth, no arms, no legs, no headphones, no other accessories.
Composition: square 1:1 canvas, single character fully in frame, centered, straight-on view, about 10% clear margin on every side.
Constraints: true transparent alpha background, no floor, no backdrop, no scenery, no cast shadow beyond the character silhouette, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark. Match Image 1's detailed soft 3D toy style while changing the body color and adding only the described glasses.
assets.observed_after_view_image: A centered rose-pink short-plush orb; both black eyes remain visible behind fitted clear round frames; no mouth or limbs.
